input.sparql:
PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/Brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#ref>
SELECT ?sensor ?tsid ?zone WHERE {
  ?zone a brick:Zone ; brick:hasSubclassOrSelf ?zone .
  ?zone rdfs:label "Perimeter_ZN_2" .
  ?sensor brick:hasLocation ?zone .
  ?sensor a brick:ElectricPowerSensor .
  ?sensor ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid .
}
